message.content:
Below is a quick reference for the **federal public holidays** in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you’ll probably want to store these as “fixed” events in your database so you can query them later.)

| Date | Day of Week | Holiday |
|------|-------------|---------|
| Jan 1 2023 | Sunday | New Year’s Day |
| Feb 20 2023 | Monday | Family Day *(Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, Saskatchewan)* |
| Mar 31 2023 | Friday | Good Friday |
| Apr 2 2023 | Sunday | Easter Saturday (observed) |
| Apr 3 2023 | Monday | Easter Monday (observed) |
| May 22 2023 | Monday | Victoria Day |
| Jul 1 2023 | Saturday | Canada Day *(observed July 2 in most provinces)* |
| Sep 4 2023 | Monday | Labour Day |
| Oct 9 2023 | Monday | Thanksgiving Day |
| Nov 11 2023 | Wednesday | Remembrance Day |
| Dec 25 2023 | Monday | Christmas Day |
| Dec 26 2023 | Tuesday | Boxing Day |

> **Note:**  
> • If a federal holiday falls on a weekend, many employers observe it on the following Monday (e.g., Canada Day was observed on July 2, 2023).  
> • Some provinces/territories have *additional* holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, Heritage Day in Manitoba, etc.). You’ll need to pull those from a province‑specific source if you want full coverage.

---

### Quick Integration Tips

```python
# Example (Python) – Store holidays in a simple SQLite table
import sqlite3
from datetime import date

conn = sqlite3.connect('holidays.db')
c = conn.cursor()
c.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS canadian_holidays (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        holiday_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        holiday_date DATE NOT NULL UNIQUE
    )
""")

holidays_2023 = [
    ("New Year’s Day", "2023-01-01"),
    ("Family Day", "2023-02-20"),
    ("Good Friday", "2023-03-31"),
    ("Easter Saturday", "2023-04-02"),
    ("Easter Monday", "2023-04-03"),
    ("Victoria Day", "2023-05-22"),
    ("Canada Day", "2023-07-01"),
    ("Labour Day", "2023-09-04"),
    ("Thanksgiving Day", "2023-10-09"),
    ("Remembrance Day", "2023-11-11"),
    ("Christmas Day", "2023-12-25"),
    ("Boxing Day", "2023-12-26")
]

c.executemany(
    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO canadian_holidays (holiday_name, holiday_date) VALUES (?, ?)",
    holidays_2023
)
conn.commit()
```

Now you can query `SELECT * FROM canadian_holidays WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN ? AND ?` whenever you need to check whether a particular date is a holiday.

---

#### Want More Detail?

For a complete, up‑to‑date list—including provincial holidays—you can consult:

* [Government of Canada – Public Holidays](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/jobs/benefits/public-holidays.html)  
* Or use a paid service such as [Calendarific](https://calendarific.com/) or [HolidayAPI](https://holidayapi.com/) if you need automated updates.

Let me know if you’d like help pulling in provincial holidays or setting up a scheduled job to keep your holiday list fresh!
